"skillfully click the link to access the printable version and start filling the Sudoku grid using the numbers 1 through 9, ensuring each digit appears only once in every row, column and 3×3 box.

This puzzle offers a temporary twist on the classic number challenge, inviting you to test your logic while thinking about broader topics like climate and gas emissions that shape our world.

Consider the weight of each decision as you place numbers, remembering that the solution will be revealed only when you purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition.

When you finally see the completed puzzle, you’ll appreciate how the simple rules create a satisfying and complete picture."
